steps.caption: The sidebar on the left is the map of the whole app, grouped into main, Records, Work and More.
Today is your start page: everything that needs you today, in one place.
Recommended next actions: lease dates and overdue tasks, most urgent first.
Today's schedule: every meeting with time, place and whether its brief is ready.
Priority accounts: the companies most worth your time, with 'See why' for the reasons.
New signals, follow-ups that are due and approvals waiting for you.
Active transactions: deals in offers, approvals or execution, with what is blocking each.
Important lease events and lease alerts: lease dates coming up and alerts from Leases.
Today also has tabs at the top: Overview, Tasks and Calendar.
Ask AI answers questions about your own data and shows where each answer came from.
Ready-made questions get you started; or type your own in the box.
Step 1 of the flow — information comes in. Capture is where you add notes, voice, photos and files.
Speak, Type or Photo: three ways to record what happened after a call or visit.
Recent captures lists what you saved and how many changes each one is proposing.
Step 2 — Review. Nothing changes your records until you approve it here.
Changes from captures, imports and automations wait here, each with its evidence.
You can approve, edit, ask to clarify or reject each proposed change.
Step 3 — Records. Companies is every account you track.
Filter by name, or add a company by hand.
People: the contacts at those companies.
Buildings: campuses, towers and the space in them.
Supply: available space, operators and matching it to requirements.
Requirements: what each client is looking for — size, place, dates. Filter by status.
Deals: every opportunity as a pipeline, from research to fee collected.
Each column is a stage; the Deals tabs also hold Financials, Documents and Fees.
Step 4 — Act. Outreach: who to contact today and drafts of what to say.
Drafts only — you always send from your own mail or WhatsApp. CRE OS never sends.
Meetings: prepare a brief before each meeting and log what happened after.
Transactions: offers, approvals, execution and handover for a confirmed requirement.
Leases: every lease, its dates, renewals and obligations — the radar is a tab inside.
Deal toolkit: compare buildings, cost a lease, stay-or-move and make client packs.
Signals: news and events that may mean a company needs space — checked before you trust them.
More holds the less-used screens. Open it.
Scores rank who to focus on first; Find contacts finds and verifies decision-makers.
Research looks into one company and builds a dossier with sources.
Market & reports: market data, network, legal, content and reports.
Intelligence: what changed, what to do next, history and memory quality.
Automation: what runs in the background, schedules, chains and failures.
Imports bring in spreadsheets; Database and Places are for browsing and setup.
Tutorials: these videos, any time.
The whole loop: things come in → you Review → records update → Today tells you what to act on.
